title: Cobblemon Full Restore
description: Recover your lost Pokémon after crashes, disconnects, or save corruption.
body:
**Cobblemon Full Restore** adds a simple and safe `/cfr` command suite that lets you backup and restore a player's Cobblemon PC and Party data using snapshot files (`.dat.old`).

Perfect for singleplayer players who frequently lose Pokémon due to crashes or connection issues.

**Commands**
- `/cfr backup`  - ``Everyone`` - Backup your own Pokémon data
- `/cfr backup <player>`  - ``OP 2+`` - Backup another player's data
- `/cfr restore`  - ``Everyone`` - Restore your own data (confirmation required)
- `/cfr restore <player>`  - ``OP 2+`` - Restore another player's data
- `/cfr restore cancel`  - ``Everyone`` - Cancel a pending restore
- `/cfr status`  - ``Everyone`` - Check if backup files exist
- `/cfr status <player>`  - ``OP 2+`` - Check another player's backup status
- `/cfr help`  - ``Everyone`` - Show command reference

How It Works

- `/cfr backup` creates safe snapshot files (.dat.old) of your current PC and Party.
- `/cfr restore` replaces the active .dat files with the backup snapshots.
- **Safety First**: Requires two-step confirmation (run command twice within 30 seconds). Before restoring, your current data is automatically saved as `.dat.crash.<timestamp>` so nothing is permanently lost.
